supernovaelabs.description: Supernovae Labs is an Italian consulting company specialized in fintech and innovation in financial markets. With an international team and a wide network of partners, Supernovae Labs has earned recognition as the Best Fintech Accelerator for its innovation capabilities and international network.

supernovahub.description: Supernova Hub is a certified incubator born in the manufacturing sector, specialized in E-commerce and Intelligent Logistics. With a particular focus on long-term sustainability, it has successfully supported 12 Startups in the growth phase. The founder and CEO, Federico Pozzi Chiesa, has extensive experience in the international logistics sector and has created several successful companies, such as Sendabox and Termostore. techbricks.description: TechBricks is a deep-tech venture studio that focuses on innovation and social and environmental impact. techinnova.name: Techinnova
techinnova.description: Techinnova is a laboratory for R&D projects and investments with a network of over 600 international stakeholders. It focuses on high-tech innovation and open innovation, supporting innovative startups through the INNOGROW acceleration program. With experience in managing R&D projects, Techinnova offers services for analysis, development, and integration of innovative elements. It operates as a certified incubator for high-tech startups, promoting the scalability of companies. Its international network includes over 400 national stakeholders and 200 European entities. Techinnova has evolved over time acquiring expertise in sectors such as 3D printing, blockchain, and precision agriculture.

It also deals with projects in the health and innovation sector, collaborating with organizations and institutions to promote economic development and research.

tecnopolobologna.name: Tecnopolo Bologna
tecnopolobologna.description: The Technopole of Bologna, located in Ozzano dell'Emilia "Rita Levi-Montalcini", is a research, innovation and development center connected to the High Technology Network of Emilia Romagna. It hosts laboratories of the IRET Foundation, the Interdepartmental Center for Industrial Research and the social enterprise TransMed Research. It offers services to companies for innovation in the health and wellness sector, supporting technology transfer and business growth.

tecnopolodabruzzo.name: Tecnopolo d'Abruzzo
tecnopolodabruzzo.description: The Abruzzo Technopole is an industrial district designed for the development of 4.0 companies, offering complete services and modern spaces to promote the growth and innovation of businesses. With professional environments, specialized laboratories, housing services, and guaranteed security, the Abruzzo Technopole positions itself as a center of excellence for companies wishing to invest in the region.

tecnopoloferrara.name: Tecnopolo Ferrara
tecnopoloferrara.description: The Technopole of Ferrara is part of the Network of the 10 Technopoles of the regional innovation ecosystem, offering access to industrial research and technology transfer. Composed of 5 research laboratories and an innovation center, the Technopole collaborates with various university sites and organizes events and workshops to promote green projects and innovations in engineering and industry.

tecnopoloforlicesena.name: Tecnopolo Forlì-Cesena
tecnopoloforlicesena.description: The Technopole of Forlì-Cesena is an industrial research center that offers expertise and infrastructure for the development of innovation projects in the fields of artificial intelligence, agri-food and aerospace. It is part of a regional network of technopoles and offers support services to companies, such as needs analysis, assistance in financing and organization of in-depth events. It has specialized laboratories in mechanics, materials, agri-food and ICT.

tecnopolomodena.name: Tecnopolo Modena
tecnopolomodena.description: The Technopole of Modena offers industrial research laboratories, internationalization services, and support for companies in innovation and technology transfer. Managed by the Democenter Foundation, the Technopole is divided into two locations in Modena and Mirandola, offering cutting-edge expertise and equipment to promote the development of businesses and the territory.

tecnopoloparma.name: Tecnopolo Parma
tecnopoloparma.description: ART-ER Tecnopoli is a facility of the University of Parma that offers laboratories, services, and collaborative research projects to promote technological innovation and the patentability of ideas and projects of small and medium-sized enterprises. There are grants available to obtain funding for patents, designs, and trademarks.

tecnopolopiacenza.name: Tecnopolo Piacenza
tecnopolopiacenza.description: The Technopole of Piacenza deals with research and innovation, managing two entities, LEAP and MUSP. It organizes workshops and events to promote innovation and territorial development, collaborating with other Technopoles in the region. It offers support for projects related to circular economy, remanufacturing, and knowledge formalization. It participates in international and national initiatives to promote business growth and environmental sustainability.

tecnopoloravenna.name: Tecnopolo Ravenna
tecnopoloravenna.description: The Technopole of Ravenna is a research and innovation center that provides access to industrial research laboratories and specialized services to support companies in transitioning towards a more sustainable energy landscape. With locations in Ravenna, Faenza, and Marina di Ravenna, the Technopole focuses on sectors such as energy, environment, nautical, and innovative materials. It also offers guidance services, networking, and support to innovative start-ups.

tecnopolorimini.name: Tecnopolo Rimini
tecnopolorimini.description: The Technopole of Rimini is a center for research, innovation, and development in the province of Rimini, part of the high technology network of the Emilia-Romagna Region. It offers infrastructure, expertise, and services for businesses and the territory, promoting the matching between the demand for technological innovation and the supply of skills. It hosts industrial research laboratories and technological development, fostering the competitive growth of companies through new products and production processes. The network of Technopoles in Emilia-Romagna promotes the circulation of scientific and technological knowledge, making the region a hub of innovation at the European level.

tecnopoloroma.name: Tecnopolo Roma
tecnopoloroma.description: Tecnopolo Roma is a technological hub that promotes innovation and supports high-tech companies. With two distinct locations, it offers spaces, services, and opportunities to foster the growth and development of companies and startups.

The management team has over 120 years of experience in the financial, consulting, industrial, and research sectors. visionari.description: VISIONARI is a non-profit association made up of a dynamic and cohesive team of innovation enthusiasts. Members can actively participate in the community and support projects through donations or membership fees.

vlfip.name: VLF IP
vlfip.description: VLF IP is an innovation-ecosystem player described in the source database as: Lo Studio VLF IP è specializzato nel fornire consulenza legale interdisciplinare, supportando aziende e professionisti con un approccio personalizzato in ambito di proprietà industriale e intellettuale, e nel diritto sanitario. It offers training programs, acceleration, mentoring, and services in various sectors such as finance, communication, technology, and innovation. The company's mission is to fuel passion and make it the driving force of work and personal life.

zanichelliventure.name: Zanichelli Venture
zanichelliventure.description: Zanichelli Venture is the corporate venture capital arm of the Bologna-based publisher Zanichelli, investing in pre-seed to Series A edtech and knowledge-tech/AI copilot startups in Italy and abroad.

zcube.name: Zcube
zcube.description: Zambon is a modern pharmaceutical company committed to improving the lives of patients through innovation in the life sciences sectors. Founded in 1906, Zambon is dedicated to creating innovative solutions to improve the lives of patients, with a focus on respiratory and neurodegenerative diseases. Through Zcube, Careapt, and Open Accelerator, the company supports innovative start-ups and promotes value-based solutions in the healthcare sector. With a strong international presence and a focus on innovation and care, Zambon is committed to making patients' lives better.

zest.name: Zest
zest.description: Zest S.p.A. is a listed venture capital and open innovation group based in Roma that invests in pre-seed and seed startups through acceleration programs and runs open innovation services for corporates and the Zest HUB coworking spaces.

znext.name: ZNEXT
znext.description: ZNEXT (Zanichelli Next S.r.l.) is the corporate venture builder of Bologna-based publisher Zanichelli Editore, launched in June 2025 with a EUR 60 million budget, that co-founds startups with founders and acquires majority stakes in companies (EUR 1-15M revenue) in EdTech, Future of Work and Wellbeing; it is separate from the group's CVC arm Zanichelli Venture.
